## Layout

Upstream subtrees are mapped so that the relative links inside them keep resolving.

| Upstream path | Vendored to | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skills/rederive` | [`./`](./) | skill |

## Known limitations of this import

- docs/, assets/ and .claude-plugin/ are not vendored. Static relative-link checks found no links under skills/ to them.
- scripts/history.sh shells out to git and scripts/structure.py to python3. Both are standard tooling, not bundled dependencies.
- The skill writes .rederive/map.md and .rederive/log.md into the target repository. That is workspace state in the user's repo, not vendored content.
